thread:
jess (platform): Quick announcement: Dedicated now supports a new GPU SKU: NVIDIA H200 80GB (sku: h200-80). Initial rollout regions: eu-central-1 and ap-south-1. Reservations open 2026-04-07 09:00 UTC.

omar (infra): perf summary: in our microbenchmarks h200-80 gives ~1.5-1.7x throughput vs our h100 baseline for long-context models. Expect the usual warm-up P99 blips for first 6-12 hours as caches warm.

rachel (sales): Pricing? need to update SOW templates.

jess (platform): List price set at 1.25x h100; reserved commit discounts apply as usual. I'll drop the interim pricing table in sales-drive after this thread.

marta (solutions): Customer migration note: in-place rollover supported but run the migration checker first. Also, NVLink on ap-south-1 will be disabled at launch due to vendor constraints; call out for multi-gpu sharded setups.

devops-bot: Scheduled job reserve-capacity-1764000123 created for eu-central-1/ap-south-1. Allocation window: 2026-04-07..2026-04-09.

omar (infra): monitoring hooks added: metric names model_gpu_util_h200, h200_gpu_temp_c, h200_memory_errors. Default alert: P95 util >85% for 10m.

rachel (sales): We should cap initial org quotas to avoid noisy neighbors. Suggested soft cap?

jess (platform): Soft cap = 48 GPUs per org across the two regions for first 30 days. Escalate to capacity@redwood for exceptions. Approval queue will gate large reservations.

marta (solutions): CLI example for internal use:

``
rw capacity reserve --region eu-central-1 --sku h200-80 --count 8 --start 2026-04-07T09:00Z --end 2026-10-07T09:00Z --notes "migration proof-of-concept"
``

jess (platform): Runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/dedicated-h200 contains perf notes, rollback steps, and customer comms templates. Read before approving.

rachel (sales): thanks — I'll update the FAQ and ping customer leads who signed EAs about availability.

jess (platform): TL;DR: H200-80 available eu-central-1 + ap-south-1, reservations open 2026-04-07 09:00 UTC, soft cap 48 GPUs/org, pricing 1.25x h100 list. Ping capacity@redwood or me for edge cases. :rocket:
